## A14 · Galleries
**Counts (derived):** designs on disk 15 (16 frames − `A14-0 Category Proof`) · spec 15 (`## 1 · Grid` … `## 15 · Boxed`) · inventory 15 (line 306) · [Free] spec **0 marked** / inventory 2 (#1 Uniform Grid, #2 Masonry → by position 1 Grid, 2 Masonry) · modules declared: `lightbox` ×15, `carousel` ×2 (7, 8) — both registry §2.1 names, none invented · custom-setting slots: 0 (no control or field is promoted) · authored lists: 1 (`images[]`, all fifteen, P0·3 with add/remove/reorder) · Ghost-bound lists: the same `images[]` at Source: From posts (P0·3 Ghost-list card, no Add) in all fifteen.

Inventory names (Uniform Grid, Filmstrip Scroll, Collage Feature, Polaroid Scatter, Hover Zoom Grid, Split Scroll, Two-Tone Frames…) do not match the export's fifteen; per D11 the merge re-derives the inventory from the export, so the per-design names are not reported as findings. The inventory's **controls union** and **content line** are normative on scope and are checked below.

#### 1 · Ghost feasibility

- **consistent** — **all fifteen, authored mode** — claim: masonry is `column-count`, the carousel is a native `scroll-snap` track, the lightbox is a `<dialog>` with a native focus trap — evidence: `research-section-js-libraries.md` §2.2 (masonry walls, A14 #2), §7 `carousel` / `lightbox`, §3.1 line 127 (`lightbox` = `<dialog>` + `Element.animate()`, ~1.0 KB vanilla), FR-G8 (`popover` is Newly-available; modals use `<dialog>`) — verdict: buildable. Reaches: spec §0 settlements 1 and 4, A14-2 item 9, A14-7/8 item 9.
- **consistent** — **From posts, the binding surface (D25)** — claim: each frame ← `feature_image`, caption ← `title`, alt ← the image's Ghost alt, link ← the post — evidence: `appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §4.1 (full post scope inside `{{#foreach posts}}` carries `title`, `url`, `feature_image`, `feature_image_alt`, `feature_image_caption`), §5 (`{{#get "posts"}}` is legal on every template, resources `posts`; A14 is `bindingContext: none` + Data-group opt-in per inventory line 48), FR-H2 (Count ≤ 100 — A14's ceiling is 48) — verdict: buildable. Reaches: spec §0 Data table, every design's item 7, inventory 307.
- **needs-execution** — **From posts: "a post with no feature image is skipped and the panel says how many were"** (§0 Data, every item 7) — claim: the theme skips such posts — evidence: FR-H8 (media bindings hide the element they occupy — a guard, applied per row *after* `{{#get}}` has already returned `limit=N` rows), `research-ghost-empty-values.md` §5.2 — so on the live site a Count of 6 with two image-less posts renders **four** frames, and the canvas's "how many were skipped" note is the only place the shortfall is visible; a server-side NQL filter `feature_image:-null` would make Count honest, and nothing in the companions says whether Ghost's NQL accepts a `-null` comparison on `feature_image` — verdict: needs execution (NE-A14-1). Reaches: spec §0 Data, items 7 of 1–15, P0·5, FR-H2, FR-H4 (editor indicator), inventory 307.
- **stale-design** — **"`img_url` derivatives for the `srcset`" on authored frames** (§0 field table `image` row, item 7 of every design) — claim: the grid's sizes come from `{{img_url}}` — evidence: authored images are Inflozo assets (FR-K1/K2), bundled at deploy into `assets/images/` as a **400 / 800 / 1600 + original** rendition set (FR-J3, AD-12) and referenced via `{{asset}}`; `{{img_url}}` resizes only Ghost-hosted content images and returns any non-internal URL unchanged (`research-ghost-empty-values.md` §5.4, `img_url.js:49-61`); FR-J5 says the theme composes `srcset` from FR-J3's renditions for bundled assets and from FR-J2's `image_sizes` for Ghost content — verdict: buildable with a stated change: authored frames use `{{asset}}` + the FR-J3 rendition set (and a per-design `sizes` attribute NFR-2(1) asserts); bound frames use `{{img_url feature_image size=…}}` against `image_sizes` keys the spec must name. Reaches: spec §0 field table, items 7 of 1–15, FR-J2, FR-J3, FR-J5, NFR-2(1), AD-12.
- **stale-design** — **Findings 6: "the overlay needs the original file and Ghost does not guarantee a middle size… no 'large but not original' derivative to fall back on"** — claim: no intermediate size exists — evidence: for bundled images AD-12/FR-J3 already emit a 1600 rendition and the "original" is FR-K2's optimised upload (WebP, ≤ 2400 px, ≤ 10 MB, originals not retained — the photographer's file is never in the theme); for Ghost-hosted images `image_sizes` is theme-defined and "Ghost automatically generates copies of images at the specified sizes… on the first request" (`research-ghost-empty-values.md` §5.4) — verdict: buildable, the finding's premise is wrong on both paths: the overlay may request the 1600 rendition (authored) or an `xl`/`xxl` key (bound — moot, the lightbox is suppressed on bound frames). Reaches: spec Findings 6, §0 settlement 4 ("requests the original file"), AD-12, FR-K2, FR-J2.
- **spec-incomplete** — **bound-frame guard shape** — claim: bound frames render `feature_image` with `srcset` — evidence: `research-ghost-empty-values.md` §4.1(a) (an unguarded `srcset` becomes bogus relative URLs the browser fetches — live 404s) and §5.2 (guard the whole `<figure>`/`<a>`, never the attribute); FR-H8 (media guards must enclose any `srcset`) — verdict: buildable, but the spec never states the guard encloses the `<li>`/`<figure>` and the `srcset`, nor which `image_sizes` keys the four widths map to, nor whether `alt` falls back to `{{title}}` (Casper/Source convention, §3.3) or to `alt=""` (the spec's "empty if it has none" — defensible, since the caption already carries the title, but it must be written). Reaches: spec §0 Data, items 7, FR-H8, FR-J2.
- **spec-incomplete** — **bound zero state** — claim: "at zero the section does not render" (written for the authored list only) — evidence: FR-H4 (2) (a secondary `{{#get}}` feed renders nothing at all, heading and container together) and `appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §5 (`{{else}}` on `{{#get}}` fires only on error — emptiness must be tested inside, e.g. `{{#if posts}}` wrapping the head; a slow `{{#get}}` is aborted to an empty collection plus Ghost's `<span data-aborted-get-helper>`) — verdict: buildable with a stated change: the spec's item 8 must declare the bound zero state (nothing, head included) and the aborted-get state. Reaches: spec §0 Data, items 8 of 1–15, FR-H4, P0·5 ("A secondary feed renders nothing at zero items").
- **needs-execution** — **Hand-picked order** — claim (P0·5, adopted by A14's Data table): "the picked list is the count and the order" — evidence: `{{#get "posts" filter="id:[a,b,c]"}}` returns Ghost's default order (`published_at desc`), and `order=` cannot express an arbitrary list; the companions do not say whether `filter="id:[…]"` preserves list order — verdict: needs execution (NE-A14-2); if it does not, the compiler needs N single-id gets or the spec loses "order". Reaches: P0·5, D5, spec §0 Data table (Hand-picked), 3 Mosaic and 10 Lead and Grid ("the lead is the first post the filter returns"), FR-H2.
- **arch-gap** — **per-image `focus` (Image focus Centre · Top · Bottom)** — claim: a per-item enum compiles to `object-position` on each `<img>` — evidence: AD-3 (a control writes one attribute on the section root; per-item styling is impossible by construction), §7.3 missing-construct table item 1 (repeat over `images[]` — the directive vocabulary is still open, register 44); the PRD and the inventory never mention Image focus (grep: no hit) — it entered through the controls-prompt ground rule 10 — verdict: buildable only if the repeat construct can emit an item-scoped attribute from a content enum (`data-focus="top"` on the `<figure>`, stylesheet selects on it — AD-3 is untouched because it is content, not a control). No rule says so. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 2, field table `focus`, Findings 12, AD-3, §7.3 item 1, register 44, Appendix C (Image Picker row), FR-G3 (directive vocabulary deliverable), every category the ground rule touched.
- **consistent** — **FR-K quota and theme size** — claim: 1–48 authored images — evidence: FR-K2 (10 MB/file, 2400 px, WebP), FR-K3 (Free 100 MB / Pro 5 GB), register row 3 (self-hosted theme-upload ceiling 1 GB on the SSL vhost; Ghost(Pro) still open, owners E7/E8) — verdict: buildable; the binding constraint is the FR-K3 quota, not Ghost. Reaches: spec §0 "The count", FR-K3, register 3.

#### 2 · Contradictions

- **stale-design** — **A14-12 Captioned Rows item 5: "The caption limit is 80 characters as everywhere"** and item 10's Flagged line "the 80-character limit inherited from the shared list" — contradicted by §0 (≤ 200), the field table, 12's own item 6 and Reconciliation note 2. Two stale sentences survived the patch. Reaches: spec §12 items 5 and 10, A14-0 field table.
- **stale-design** — **Remove-at-minimum: three approved sources disagree.** P0·3: "At min: each row's Remove disables inside the overflow"; controls-prompt ground rule 8: "remove never disabled"; A14 §0 Repeating items: "Remove… never disabled… removing the last [is allowed]: the section then does not render" — while the field table declares `images[]` **list 1–48, req**. A required list whose last row can be removed has min 0, not 1. Per the brief's rule 4 this is flagged and stopped, not resolved. Reaches: P0·3, control-prompts rule 8 (library-wide), spec §0 field table + Repeating items, register 44, A15 (same conflict, its Reconciliation note 5).
- **stale-design** — **A14-11 Overlay: Caption wash "Soft" measures 3.6:1, "fails AA and is stated on the panel rather than disabled"** — P0·8 rule 3: "A value that would fail contrast is disabled with its ratio shown, never silently allowed (the A2 rule, restated as library-wide)". The spec argues the author can judge; P0·8 does not offer that exception. Reaches: spec §11 items 6 and 10, P0·8(3), FR-G4 (AA guarantee scoped to library defaults — the default Standard 4.9:1 passes, the offered value does not), A15-6 Cover (same Scrim: Soft 3.6:1).
- **stale-design** — **`carousel` edit-safe status differs across the library.** A14-7 item 9: `carousel` (**edit-safe: no**); A15-9 item 9: "**carousel, edit-safe: yes**". FR-D20: "The declaration is part of the module contract, not a per-instance setting." The likely cause is vocabulary, not substance: A4 line 19 defines "edit-safe" as "the module **does not run** while the section is being edited" (FR-D20's *opposite* — edit-safe modules "run always") and A15 inherits that sense, while A14 uses FR-D20's; under FR-D20's sense both categories mean `carousel` waits for Preview. Still one declaration per module is owed, and FR-D20's own home for it (§7.3) carries no per-module table (see §4; A15 §1 for the inversion). Reaches: A14 §7 item 9, A15 §9 item 9, FR-D20, §7.3, FR-G7.
- **spec-incomplete** — **`lightbox`, edit-safe: no — the editor-suppression guarantee is never stated** (carry-forward: "state the editor-suppression guarantee"). Every item 9 says "edit-safe: no" and §0 Editing says "the overlay is not an editing surface", but nowhere does the spec say what a click on a frame does on the canvas outside Preview: selects the item (P0·3 selection ring, both places), never opens the `<dialog>`, never follows the `<a href>` to the file. FR-D20 names exactly this case ("a modal that opens instead of selecting"). Reaches: items 9 of 1–15, §0 Editing, FR-D20, P0·3.

## A15 · Video and Embeds
**Counts (derived):** designs on disk 15 (16 frames − `A15-0 Category Proof`) · spec 15 (`## 1 · Player` … `## 15 · Tabs`) · inventory 15 (line 324) · [Free] spec **0 marked** / inventory 2 (#1 Cinema Center, #2 Split Video Copy → by position 1 Player, 2 Split) · modules declared: `video-facade` ×15 (embeds only — "on Source: Upload no module is declared"), `carousel` ×1 (9), `tabs` ×2 (10, 15) — three registry §2.1 names, none invented; `lightbox` refused by name; three "ARCHITECT: registry addition" flags (11 seek · 12 non-video facade · reduced-motion gate on Ambient loop, all fifteen) and the `tabs` ruling flag on 10 and 15 · custom-setting slots: 0 · authored lists: 2 (`videos[]` all fifteen; `chapters[]` on 11) · Ghost-bound lists: 0 (the spec declares no From posts branch — see §2).

Inventory names (Cinema Center, Poster Modal, Episode List, Podcast Player Row, Floating Frame, Device Mock…) do not match the export's fifteen; per D11 the merge re-derives from the export and the names are not reported. The inventory's **controls union, content line and Data sentence** (line 325) are normative on scope and are checked below.

#### 1 · Ghost feasibility

- **ghost-infeasible** — **Source: Upload — "a file in Ghost's media library"** (§0 What A15 is, Data, field table `url`, items 7/9 of 1–15, Reconciliation 1 and 4) — claim: the editor's Add takes a file from Ghost's media library and the theme plays it as `<video controls playsinline preload="none" poster>` — evidence: the Content API exposes Posts, Pages, Tags, Authors, Tiers, Settings, Newsletters (FR-H1, Appendix B) — **no media resource**; the Admin API is reached only through `apps/web/server/ghost-admin/*` and AD-10's write allowlist is **four items** (theme upload, theme activate, `routes.yaml` upload, announcement clear) — no media upload and Ghost's Admin API has no media *listing* endpoint at all; Inflozo's own library is **Image / SVG / Logo** (FR-K1) with a raster-only WebP pass (FR-K2) — no video type, and FR-J3 bundles `assets/images/` only — verdict: **not buildable as written**; buildable with a stated change, one of: (a) a **Video asset type** in FR-K1/K2/K5 + FR-J3 (`assets/media/`, `{{asset}}`, no transcode, FR-K2's 10 MB cap, FR-K3 quota), or (b) "Upload" means **paste the URL of a file already uploaded through Ghost's own editor** (`/content/media/…` — first-party for the reader, no picker; duration readable via `loadedmetadata` cross-origin; the poster must be the author's image). D27 assumed a home existed; none does. Reaches: spec §0, items 7/9 of 1–15, D27, FR-K1, FR-K2, FR-K5, FR-J3, AD-10, AD-12, Appendix B, inventory 325.
- **needs-execution** — **Editor-side seeding "fetches the oEmbed title and duration once"** (§0 Data, settlement 3 amendment, field table `title`/`duration`/`poster`, 10 Playlist's running total, Reconciliation 3–4) — claim: every recognised provider's oEmbed returns title + duration and the editor can fetch it — evidence (external-platform facts, AD-23 requires them as fixtures, none exist): YouTube's oEmbed payload carries **no `duration`** (title, author, type, dimensions, provider, thumbnail, html) — a duration needs the Data API v3 (`videos?part=contentDetails`, keyed, quota'd); Vimeo's oEmbed does carry `duration`; Apple Podcasts and Bandcamp publish **no oEmbed endpoint**; Spotify, SoundCloud and Mixcloud do; and YouTube's oEmbed sends no `Access-Control-Allow-Origin`, so a browser fetch from the editor is blocked — AD-10 has exactly two API paths, both Ghost's, and a third-party proxy is a **third path** — verdict: needs execution (NE-A15-1); until then "seeded on paste" is true for Vimeo/Spotify/SoundCloud/Mixcloud titles and for Vimeo durations only. Reaches: spec §0 Data (seeding), §10 item 7, §12 item 7, AD-10, AD-13, AD-23, D27 context, appendix-h1 (no key yet for a "could not fetch" editor state — app string).
- **arch-gap** — **"Use provider thumbnail downloads the image and re-hosts it as the poster"** — claim: the editor fetches and re-hosts — evidence: AD-12 (renditions are made **in the browser at upload** through FR-K2's `canvas.toBlob` pass); a server-fetched thumbnail either bypasses that pass or must be handed back to the browser; AD-10 has no third-party path; AD-13 (nothing large crosses a function boundary — a thumbnail is small, but the path is unnamed) — verdict: buildable with a stated mechanism; **no owner; needs one**. Reaches: spec settlement 3, field table `poster`, Reconciliation 3, AD-10, AD-12, AD-13.
- **consistent** — **Third-party iframes vs FR-G7's zero-third-party rule** — claim (implicit in every embed design): the theme may load a provider iframe on the reader's click — evidence: FR-G7(1)'s enforcement is "compile CI asserts that `assets/js/` contains only files authored in the Inflozo repository" — an `<iframe>` is markup, not shipped JavaScript; NFR-2's 40 KB budget is measured over `assets/js/main.js` alone (`research-section-js-libraries.md` §1 line 42, register row 27); the registry's own `video-facade` row exists **because** "a cold YouTube iframe is ~500 KB+ of third-party JS on a page whose own budget is 40 KB" (research §2.1 #15, §4 lines 379–383: "`video-facade` is not optional") — verdict: buildable; the spec argues privacy (settlement 3) and should cite FR-G7(1)/§2.1 #15 once so the question stops being asked. Reaches: spec settlement 3, §12, FR-G7(1), NFR-2, research §2.1 #15.
- **spec-incomplete** — **Provider URL parsing: compile-time, never runtime** (§0 Data "the provider is derived from the URL", field table `url` and `start`, §11 item 9, §12 item 7) — claim: the provider, its embed URL, its canonical watch URL and the `start` parameter are derived from the pasted URL — the spec never says **where**. Evidence: the served HTML must already carry the canonical `<a href>` (research §7 `video-facade`; A4 finding 1: "the served markup must be the no-JS one"), so the parse cannot live in the module; AD-36 ("parse and rebuild from validated parts — never interpolate") makes the embed-host allowlist and id grammar (`youtube.com/watch?v=`, `youtu.be/`, `/shorts/`, `m.youtube.com`, `vimeo.com/{id}`, `vimeo.com/{id}/{hash}`, `player.vimeo.com/video/{id}`, `open.spotify.com/{type}/{id}`…) a new AD-36 instance; the `start` value the author types ("1:32", ≤ 8 chars) must be parsed to seconds and emitted in each provider's own syntax (`?t=92s` on a YouTube watch page, `?start=92` on its embed, `#t=1m32s` on Vimeo, `#t=92` media fragment on a file) — verdict: buildable with a stated change: the compiler (and the editor at paste, for the label) parses; the module receives finished URLs via `data-*`. #### 4 · Architecture asks

- **A home for uploaded media** (video now; audio per research §2.2). Owner: FR-K1/K2/K5 + FR-J3 (asset types, bundling) or a "Ghost media URL" field — **no owner; needs one**; D27 depends on it.
- **Third-party fetches from the editor** (oEmbed seeding, thumbnail re-host). Owner: AD-10 (a third path, server-side, allowlisted hosts) + AD-23 (recorded provider fixtures) + AD-13 — **no owner; needs one**.
- **The theatre's module.** Owner: FR-G7 / research §2.1 rows 14–15 — `lightbox` (registry's partition, edit-safe: no) or a modal branch inside `video-facade` (registry change). **No owner; needs one.** Every theatre design becomes multi-module under the first answer.
- **Multi-module sections — A15-9 (`carousel` + `video-facade`), A15-10 and A15-15 (`tabs` + `video-facade`)** — the carry-forward's blessing; FR-G7(2) is singular; register 45 does not cover composition. **No owner; needs one** (with A14-7/8, A22-14).
- **Edit-safe vocabulary and table.** FR-D20 cites §7.3 for the per-module declaration; §7.3 has none, and A4/A15 use the word inverted. Owner: FR-D20 → §7.3 (prd-defect) — one 31-row table with FR-D20's sense.
- **`tabs` heading branch** (10, 15). Owner: FR-G7 §7 `tabs` — carry-forward, verified flagged on both frames.
- **Reduced-motion gate for Ambient loop → `core`** (FR-G7(4)); serve without `autoplay`. Owner: E4 `core` — exists; the spec's "registry addition" flag should be retired.
- **`start` and seek** — compile-time URL param; seek-in-place optional under `video-facade`. Owner: FR-G7 — record.
- **Generic embed facade** — already `video-facade`'s remit (research §3.1 line 128); §7 wording. Owner: research §7 — one clause.
- **Provider parsing as an AD-36 instance** — host allowlist, id grammar, embed/watch URL templates, `start` syntax per provider, at compile and at paste. Owner: AD-36 — needs the instance added and its test in `tools/stress/test-ad36.js`.
- **Dead/private embed URL** — an editor/pre-deploy check, not a published state. Owner: FR-F6's compile re-validation is internal-only — **no owner; needs one** (FR-J13-class warning).
- **Per-item kind and per-item `focus` in the repeat construct.** Owner: §7.3 item 1 / register 44.
- **Data-group semantics** for Playback/Source. Owner: FR-F3 — move Playback to Arrangement; Source is an item fact.
- **Theme size with media.** Register row 3: 1 GB self-hosted (SSL vhost); Ghost(Pro) open (E7/E8). Bounded first by FR-K2/K3. Consistent; cite.
- **Route-awareness / pack tokens:** not raised by A15. "One player at a time" (7, 8, 13) and "advancing/switching destroys the player" (9, 15) are `video-facade` contract lines the registry row should carry.

- **Ten fields:** all fifteen carry items 1–10. Complete.
- **Tuples:** fifteen, six slots. First five on vocabulary — archetype {media frame ×6, split ×2, grid-of-N ×2, overlay, carousel, table, stack, bar} ✓; containment {none ×14, box} ✓; ground {page ×9, surface ×3, contrast, transparent, image} ✓; count {one ×8, many ×5, few, variable} ✓; media {top ×5, inline ×4, left ×3, right, full-bleed, background} ✓. **Off-vocabulary words: none. First-five collisions: none** (1/3/4/5/12/15 separate on ground, containment or count; 7/8 on media; 2/10 on ground+count+media). `tuple-check-specs.txt` line 15 agrees (disk 15 · tuples 15 · OK).
- **No-JS lines:** see §2 — `video-facade` quoted in 2 of 15; `carousel` quoted in 9; `tabs` quoted in 10 and 15 (with the ruling flag). `spec-incomplete` on 13 designs.
- **Lists:** `videos[]` and `chapters[]` authored → paste/file Add, Remove (never disabled — conflict), drag ✓; no Ghost-bound list (register 44 — none owed). 11 carries two P0·3 blocks — fine.
- **Controls:** 4–6 own per design, three Quick Controls each, the trio outside, no px in a sidebar value ("Audio bar" is a named Shape value; "160 px" is a spec reading). Locked: Background role 4/5/6, Plays on 6 (theatre) and 11 (frame); disabled: 5's 1:1/9:16 and theatre, 12/14's Ambient loop — A9·8 convention with reasons ✓. 37 control-written values named; `playback` mis-grouped (§2).

- **Custom-setting slots:** 0. Nothing promoted; nothing says "expose to Ghost Admin".

## A16 · Contact

**Counts (derived):** designs on disk **15** (16 `A16-*` frames − `A16-0 Category Proof`) · spec **15** (`### 1 · Split` … `### 15 · Cover`) · inventory **15** (`sections-inventory.md` line 342 "A16. Contact (15)") · [Free] spec **0 markers anywhere** (spec text and proof frame both grep-clean for `[Free]`; FR-G2's rule makes #1 Split and #2 Centred the Free pair) / inventory **2** (#1 Center Card, #2 Split Info — lines 344–345) · modules declared: spec text → `contact-form` on 1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 7, 11, 12, 14, 15 (ten), `none` on 6, 8, 9, 10, 13; **frames' own field 9 → `member-form` on all ten** (see 2.1); registry §2.1 has **no** `contact-form` (it is the carry-forward's addition, not an entry) · custom-setting slots: **0 by default, 1 when `deliveryTarget` is promoted** (FR-Q3 text prop → text; 17 user slots after FR-Q5's three) · authored lists: **4** — `socials[]` (1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12), `locations[]` (7, 8), `enquiries[]` (11, 13), `reasons[]` (14) · Ghost-bound lists: **0** (the "Social accounts: From Ghost" rows are nine guarded `@site.*` fields rendered read-only, not a list source; the contact block is four fixed fields, not a list).

Sources read in full: `A16 Contact - Spec.md` (1,455 lines), the ten form frames' field-9 text and the proof frame (grep), `P0 Editor Primitives - Spec.md` P0·3/P0·4/P0·6/P0·8, PRD FR-D/F/G/H/J/Q, Appendix B/C/G, §7.3 missing-construct table, `research-section-js-libraries.md` §2.1/§2.2/§7, `appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §2/§6/§7/§8, `appendix-h1-string-catalog.md` §1/§3.4/§3.12/§5/§7, `research-ghost-binding-contexts.md` `@site` allowlist (lines 121–167), `research-ghost-membership-pages.md` lines 426–432 and 780–805, ARCHITECTURE-SPINE AD-2/AD-3/AD-30/AD-36, VERIFY-AT-BUILD rows 44–46.

#### 1 · Ghost feasibility

- **consistent** — **the whole form family (1–5, 7, 11, 12, 14, 15)** — claim: "Ghost's theme layer has no form handler — no route, no endpoint, no storage" (§0 settlement 3, finding 1) — evidence: `research-ghost-membership-pages.md` line 428 (every route in the members app is JSON or a redirect; the one HTML-ish route consumes `?token=` and redirects), `sections-inventory.md` line 342 ("No form backend in Ghost") — verdict: **buildable with a stated change, and the change is D28** (script-composed `mailto:` at *An email address*; native cross-origin POST at *A form service*). One loose end: the spec names `/members/api/send-magic-link/` as the only address-accepting endpoint; that path is not in the companion's route list (which names `/members/api/member`, `/session`, `/entitlements`, `/integrity-token`, `/comments`, the two Stripe routes, `/subscriptions/:id`). The conclusion does not depend on it. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 3, finding 1, inventory line 342.
- **needs-execution** — **`deliveryTarget` / "there is no site address to fall back to"** (§0 settlement 2 and 3, finding 8, recon note 3, delivery group row 2) — claim: "Ghost exposes no site address to a theme", so the original fallback was withdrawn and an empty destination blocks publishing — evidence: `research-ghost-binding-contexts.md` line 151 lists **`@site.members_support_address` as documented, in the public allowlist, fresh-install default `'noreply'`**; `research-ghost-membership-pages.md` lines 618/881 confirm the Content API returns it. The undocumented `support_email_address` is a different, calculated key and is on appendix-b1 §6's never-offer list; `members_support_address` is not. So a site address **does** exist in template context — but its default is the literal token `noreply` (Ghost resolves it to `noreply@<domain>` only when sending mail), so it is unusable as a `mailto:` target unless the owner set a real address in Settings → Membership. Verdict: **needs execution** (NE-A16-1). If the probe shows a real address when set, the withdrawn fallback is restorable behind `{{#if}}` plus a `noreply` guard and the publish block (F-2.26) can soften to a warning. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 3, finding 8, recon note 3, delivery group `deliveryTarget`, component inventory "The destination setting", Appendix B `@site` list (which omits the key).
- **ghost-infeasible** — **`locations[]` Add "seeded with the site's own city and a placeholder address"** (§Repeating items, design 7 §10, design 8 §10) — claim: the editor knows the site's city — evidence: the `@site` allowlist (`research-ghost-binding-contexts.md` lines 121–167) carries no address, city or location key; the spec's own findings 4 and 8 say so — verdict: **not buildable as written**; seed with the fixture's fixed placeholder (Orbit Weekly's city) and say so. Reaches: spec §Repeating items `locations[]`, design 7 §10, design 8 §10, P0·3 ("placeholder copy is named per category").
- **spec-incomplete** — **Prefill for members, On by default** (delivery group row 5, §Members, field list) — claim: `@member.name` / `@member.email` render server-side into the fields with no script — evidence: legal in every template on every version (`appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §2 and §6 "the whole `@member` shape byte-identical 5.130.6 → HEAD"). Two things the spec does not state: (a) `@member.name` is null for a member who signed up without a name — FR-H8's text rule applies (fall back to the static placeholder), and the spec must say the guard is emitted; (b) **`research-ghost-membership-pages.md` line 798: under `cacheMembersContent:enabled` member responses are cached publicly per tier**, so a page that server-renders `@member.email` into a form field is served to other members on that tier — the exact hazard the A30 research names for account pages. Verdict: buildable with a stated change — ship Off by default, or On with the hazard stated on the panel and in the contact-form entry; owner to rule. Reaches: spec delivery group `prefillMembers`, §Members, field list, FR-D16, A30 (same hazard), §7.6.
- **spec-incomplete** — **Social accounts: From Ghost** (1, 5, 6, 9, 10, 12; §Icons, §Repeating items `socials[]`, field list) — claim: "version-gated, Facebook and X on Ghost 5.x, all nine platform fields on ≥ 6.36, each read-only and linking to the setting that owns it" — evidence: the gate is right (`appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §6: seven fields ≥ 6.36.0; `{{#social_accounts}}` ≥ 6.38.0 is a gscan error below it; `{{twitter_url}}`/`{{facebook_url}}` are gscan-warned; `{{social_url}}` is un-gated). What the spec never names is **the helper**: the build must emit `{{social_url type="…"}}` for all nine and never `{{#social_accounts}}` or the two deprecated helpers — nothing in the spec would catch a build that picks the ≥ 6.38 block helper. Whether `{{social_url}}` derives correct URLs for the seven new types (Mastodon is instance-qualified) is asserted by `research-ghost-binding-contexts.md` line 1129 from source only → NE-A16-2. Second gap: "Source: From Ghost · Authored … Ghost's rows render regardless and do not count against the six" — if Ghost's rows render regardless of the Source value, what does *Authored* do? State it (either Source is "Ghost's rows + authored rows: on/off", or the enum is two exclusive sources). Reaches: spec §Icons, §Repeating items `socials[]`, field list `socialsSource`, designs 1/5/6/9/10/12 §6, D22, FR-H7 (the editor must hide the seven rows on a 5.x connection, not render them empty).
- **arch-gap** — **`deliveryTarget` promoted to a Ghost custom text setting** (delivery group row 2, finding 8, component inventory) — claim: "an Inflozo project setting, promotable to a Ghost Admin custom setting (text) — the owner changes it without a redeploy; validated per mode; empty is editor-only and blocks publishing" — evidence: FR-Q3 (text prop → text, plain string), AD-3 ("a promoted control emits `data-{control}="{{@custom.key}}"`"), AD-36 #1 and #4 ("the value arrives at runtime, on the customer's site, after every build-time gate has run"). Three consequences the spec does not carry: (a) the promoted value goes into `action="…"` / `href="mailto:…"` — a URL sink, not a data-attribute — and **no per-mode validation can run in Ghost Admin**: the owner can type `http://`, a bare word, or `javascript:`; (b) **the publish block cannot hold post-deploy** — the owner blanks the setting in Ghost Admin and the live form has no destination, which is the exact state the spec says "cannot publish"; (c) `deliveryMode` is not promoted, so an owner who swaps an address for a service URL in Ghost Admin gets `mailto:https://…` composed. Verdict: buildable with stated changes — the template wraps the form in `{{#if @custom.contact_destination}} … {{else}}<the no-destination rendering>{{/if}}` (FR-H8), the module validates the destination against the mode before composing and refuses to an inert state (AD-36's "reject to inert `#`" rule), and the panel says what happens when the owner blanks it. Reaches: FR-Q2/Q3 (slot count 1), AD-3 promotion sentence, AD-36, spec delivery group, finding 8, recon note 3, F-2.26 (the gate).
- **spec-incomplete** — **11 Enquiry Types at *A form service*** (design 11 §6/§7, delivery group "the one design where the destination defers to a list") — claim: "each enquiry carries its own address, and the group's single destination is the fallback" — evidence: a form service has one endpoint (the pasted URL); a selected radio's `address` can only travel as a POSTed field value the service does not route on. Per-type destinations are real only at *An email address* (the script composes the `mailto:` to the selected type's address — design 11 §Patched says exactly this). Verdict: buildable with a stated change — at *A form service* the per-type `address` is a posted field (or hidden) and the panel says routing is the service's business; and the no-JS *An email address* state must say which "Email us at …" line shows for the checked radio (CSS `:has(:checked)` is Baseline Widely 2026-06-19 per registry §2.2, so N lines can switch without script — say so, or the no-JS line shows the fallback address only). Reaches: spec design 11 §6/§7/§9, delivery group, contact-form degradation sentence, finding 3.
- **spec-incomplete** — **"Show the message in place" at *A form service*** (delivery group `afterSending`, settlement 2 failed state) — claim: the service answers and the section shows the sent state in place — evidence: none cited; this implies a `fetch()` to the pasted endpoint with the service's AJAX contract (`Accept: application/json`, CORS on the service's side, 2xx vs 4xx, redirect-to-HTML on success for services that only do native POST). Nothing in the spec catches a service whose success answer is a 302 the fetch follows to an HTML page — which the module would read as "failed". Verdict: state the contract: at *The service's own page* the module does **not** intercept submit; at *Show the message in place* it fetches with `Accept: application/json`, treats non-2xx and opaque redirects as *failed*, and the failed banner names the service. Reaches: spec delivery group `afterSending`, settlement 2, the contact-form registry entry (to be written), `research-section-js-libraries.md` §7.
- **spec-incomplete** — **eight states × two delivery modes — no matrix** (settlement 2, delivery captions "Form-state copy", P0·6 list, field list `sentText` "names the address that was typed") — claim: submitting / sent / failed are script states "on either path" — evidence: at *An email address* the script opens a mail app and **cannot observe** whether a draft opened, was sent, or was discarded (no mail client configured is the common desktop case); `afterSending` is "disabled at *An email address* — the mail app is the response". So: does the section shrink to *sent* on click, before anything happened? Is *failed* reachable at all in that mode, when "the way out" the banner offers **is** the action that was just taken? Verdict: state which of the eight states each mode reaches; the honest mailto path is likely empty · focus · invalid · no destination · no script only, fire-and-forget, with sent/failed reserved for *A form service*. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 2, delivery group captions, P0·6 (A16's state list), field list `sentHeading`/`sentText`/`failedText`, component inventory "The seven form states".
- **spec-incomplete** — **the no-script state's `<form>` mechanics** (settlement 2 "no script", §The degradation statement, designs 2 and 15) — claim: with JS off at *An email address* "the fields stay, a visible mailto line sits under them, and the submit button is not rendered" — evidence: the server cannot know JS state, so the button is emitted and hidden under `core`'s `.js-enabled`-absent branch (registry §7 `core` row) — fine; but at *Email and message* (2 Centred, 15 Cover's fixed set, any design at that value) the form holds exactly one text input plus a textarea, and **HTML implicit submission fires on Enter in the email field when a form has no submit button and only one field that blocks implicit submission** — the form then posts to whatever `action` it has (the page's own Ghost route if none). The spec never states the `<form>`'s `action`/`method` at *An email address*. Verdict: state it — `method="dialog"` outside a `<dialog>` aborts submission natively, or the no-JS branch renders no `<form>` element around the fields; and say why. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 2, §The degradation statement, designs 2 §10 and 15 §10, the contact-form registry sentence.
- **spec-incomplete** — **the honeypot** (delivery captions "Spam", finding 6, §Strings) — claim: "a hidden honeypot plus the service's own guard" — evidence: at *An email address* nothing reads the honeypot (no server; a script-side check is bypassed by anything that never runs the script, which has no submit path anyway) — it is inert, and the caption implies protection that does not exist in the default mode; at *A form service* the field **name** is service-specific (`_gotcha`, `netlify-honeypot`, `_honey`…) and the spec names none, so the service ignores it. Verdict: caption says "at *An email address* there is nothing to spam"; at *A form service* the honeypot field name is a text input beside the endpoint or the caption says the service's guard is the only guard. Its visually-hidden label needs a catalog key (see 2.9). Reaches: spec delivery captions, finding 6, §Strings, appendix-h1.
- **spec-incomplete** — **no character limit on the message field** (§Shared floor "The message field", field list) — claim: the message is a box of 96/144/216 px, "the only field whose height is a control" — evidence: every other authored field in the table carries a limit; the message carries none, and at *An email address* the message becomes a **URL** (`mailto:?body=…`) — mail clients and OS URL handlers truncate long `mailto:` URLs silently. Verdict: a stated cap at *An email address* (shown as a counter) or a stated "long messages are truncated by the mail app" line in the panel. Reaches: spec §Shared floor, field list, the contact-form registry entry.
- **spec-incomplete** — **Directions: From address "builds a maps-search URL out of the address"** (designs 7/8 `directionsMode`, component inventory "The directions link") — claim: no provider is needed — evidence: a maps-*search* URL names a provider (Google `…/maps/search/?api=1&query=`, Apple `maps.apple.com/?q=`, OSM); FR-G7 rule 1 is untouched (nothing fetched at render) but the destination is a third party the spec does not name, the address must be percent-encoded, and the emitted href is an AD-36 #1 sink. Verdict: name the URL template once, in the contact-form/registry notes or FR-F6 (a new link kind), with `rel="noopener"` per D9. Reaches: spec designs 7 §6, 8 §6, component inventory, FR-F6, AD-36.
- **spec-incomplete** *(verification-gap)* — **"`<form method="post" action="mailto:…">` does not work and never did"** (§0 settlement 3, recon note 1) — claim: a browser fact, asserted with no evidence; historically Firefox and Chromium open a draft with `enctype="text/plain"` bodies, and behaviour differs by OS mail handler. D28 is ruled and the design stands regardless; recorded so the sentence is read as the ruling's rationale, not as a verified fact. Reaches: spec §0 settlement 3, recon note 1, D28.

## A17 · Post Grids
**Counts (derived):** designs on disk 18 (19 frames `A17-0`…`A17-18` − proof) · spec 18 (`### 1 · Three Up` … `### 18 · Edge to Edge`) · inventory 18 (`sections-inventory.md` line 362 "Post Grids (18)") · [Free] spec **none marked** (`grep -c Free` = 0 in the spec and in `A17-0 Category Proof.dc.html`) / inventory #1 Classic Cards, #2 Minimal Title Grid · modules declared: `filter-strip` (15), `load-more` (16) — both registry names (`research-section-js-libraries.md` §2.1 #28, #24); `core` assumed · custom-setting slots: 0 (no design promotes a field) · authored lists: 1 (15 Filtered "Chosen tags" — tag refs) · Ghost-bound lists: 18 (the posts query, P0·5 in every design) + 15's strip at "From these posts"/"All site tags"; the Hand-picked `postRefs` picker is a reference list (drag-to-order, × to unpick, no Add that creates a post).

**Roster note (derive, don't trust):** the inventory's 18 names (lines 364–381: Classic Cards, Minimal Title Grid, Magazine Mixed, Bento Editorial, Overlay Cards, Horizontal Cards, Masonry Feed, Numbered Ranked, Wide Duo, Dense Four, Serif Editorial, Gradient Hover, Frame Border, Photo Square, Tag-Chip Cards, Meta-Rich Rows, Alternating Size, Spotlight Rail) and the spec's 18 (Three Up, Two Up, Four Up, Cards, Lead + Grid, Split Head, Contrast Band, Overlay, Big Type, Ledger, Masonry, Bento, Thumb Side, Dense, Filtered, Load More, Panel, Edge to Edge) agree on the count only. Nine inventory designs have no spec counterpart (Numbered Ranked, Serif Editorial, Gradient Hover, Frame Border, Photo Square, Tag-Chip Cards, Meta-Rich Rows, Alternating Size, Spotlight Rail) and nine spec designs are new (Split Head, Contrast Band, Ledger, Filtered, Load More, Panel, Edge to Edge, Thumb Side, Big Type). See §2.

#### 1 · Ghost feasibility
- **ghost-infeasible** — **A17-15 Filtered, Tags: "From these posts"** — claim: "the strip lists the distinct primary tags of the posts actually drawn … every pill has at least one post behind it" (spec §15 field 7). Evidence: Handlebars/Ghost has no distinct/unique or set operation — `research-ghost-empty-values.md` §3.1 ("Ghost ships no subexpression logic helpers at all"); `appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §4.1 lists the only loop-local data (`@index`, `@number`, `@first`, `@last`, `@even`, `@odd`, `@key`, `@rowStart/@rowEnd`) and no cross-item state; `{{#get "tags"}}` cannot be filtered by "tags of *these* posts" because a `{{#get}}` filter may reference only template-level context (FR-H5, FR-G3, appendix-b1 §5). A client-side dedupe would contradict the module's own quoted no-JS line ("works perfectly"). Verdict: **not buildable on Ghost** as specified. Stated change: drop the value; keep "All site tags" (`{{#get "tags" filter="visibility:public" order="count.posts desc" limit="N"}}`, appendix-b1 §5) and "Chosen tags" (authored refs). Reaches: spec §15 fields 6/7/8 and its Reconciled paragraph, Block 1 "Tag pill", Reconciliation notes ("15 had `filter-strip` redefined"), registry §2.1 #28 (control reach), FR-G7 rule 3, inventory line 378.
- **ghost-infeasible** — **Feature "First cell spans two" (1, 3, 4, 11, 15, 16), 5 Lead + Grid, 12 Bento "Tall cell: Featured post"** — claim: "More than one flagged → only the first in the set's order spans" (§0 settlement 3); 5 "reads `featured`; with nothing featured it promotes the newest post"; 12 "nothing flagged falls back to First in order, and more than one flagged takes the first in the set". Evidence: "first flagged only" needs state across `{{#foreach}}` iterations, which Handlebars does not have (appendix-b1 §4.1 loop vars; research-ghost-empty-values §3.1 no logic helpers). The two-query form (`{{#get}}` featured limit 1 + a second `{{#get}}` excluding it by `id:-…`) references the first block's render context in the second filter — forbidden by FR-H5/FR-G3 — and is unavailable on the main feed, which is the native `posts` context and admits no `{{#get}}` (FR-H2). Verdict: **not buildable on Ghost** as specified. Stated change: Feature becomes **positional** — `@first` spans (appendix-b1 §4.1), and Order/Hand-picked decide which post is first; `featured` reaches a grid only through Source: Featured only. This is what 5's "promotes the newest" and A18-10's "the lead is a position" already do. Reaches: §0 settlement 3, designs 1/3/4/5/11/12/15/16 §5–§7, Block 2 ("`featured` … read by seven designs"), Findings "Closed" (12 Bento's Tall cell), §7.3 table item 5, FR-H2.
- **needs-execution** + **arch-gap** — **Hand-picked ordering (all 18)** — claim: "drag order = drawn order" (§0 Data table; Block 2 `postRefs`). Evidence: the compile shape is one `{{#get "posts" filter="id:[a,b,c]"}}`, and Ghost returns it in `order` (default `published_at desc`), never in list order — the spec's own Finding 11 says so ("Ghost's `#get` helper does not preserve an arbitrary order for free"); Handlebars cannot reorder (research §3.1). One `{{#get}}` per pick (limit 1) preserves order but A17's Hand-picked ceilings are the Count bounds (24 on 1/3/4/13, 30 on 10, 100 on 16) — up to 30–100 queries per render, and appendix-b1 §5 warns a slow `{{#get}}` is aborted. Verdict: **needs execution** (probe NE-A17-1) and, whatever it finds, an ordering contract with a Hand-picked ceiling far below Count's (A19 caps its picker at the design max ≤ 5). Reaches: §0 Data table, Block 2, Findings 11, D5, P0·5 "Hand-picked", FR-H2 Source list, §7.3 item 2, A18/A19/A20/A21/A27/A3-9.
- **ghost-infeasible** — **Meta "With photograph" initials fallback (1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 11, 12, 15, 16, 17, 18)** — claim: Block 1 "Avatar in the meta row … initials block as fallback" (A12's "two-letter fallback"). Evidence: two initials need substring/first-character extraction; Ghost has no string helper for it — `{{split}}` (≥ 6.5, appendix-b1 §6) splits on a separator only; research-ghost-empty-values §3.1; Casper's own answer is an SVG avatar partial (§1.1 Pattern B, `Casper/post.hbs:38-44`). Verdict: **not buildable** as an initials block. Stated change: a glyph avatar (Casper's) or hide the circle (FR-H8 media → hide); one CSS `::first-letter` initial is the most CSS can do. Reaches: Block 1 row "Avatar in the meta row", §0 "The post card" Meta enum, the eleven designs above, A1·6, A12, A19, A21 (the component is shared).
- **ghost-infeasible** (contradicts FR-H2) — **16 Load More at any Source other than the main feed** — claim: "subsequent batches fetched against the same query" (§16 field 7) and the no-JS line "Ghost's numbered `/page/2/` pagination links render instead". Evidence: a `{{#get}}`-driven feed has no `/page/2/` — FR-H2: "All other feed sections are `{{#get}}`-driven: fixed Count, never paginated"; the registry's `load-more` (§2.1 #24) is defined for A34 #2/#7/#8 walking the route's pages, and A34-6 says "each press fetches the next `/page/N/`" and "the batch is always `posts_per_page`" (A34 spec §6 field 7). On a page/post template or as a second feed on a collection template, 16's no-JS branch renders nothing to click and its JS branch has nothing to fetch. Verdict: **not buildable** as specified. Stated change: either 16 is **main-feed-only** (at which point it is any grid + Pagination style Load more, i.e. A34-6 — its reason to exist as a separate design is gone) or the registry gains a Content-API `load-more` variant (`{{content_api_key}}`/`{{content_api_url}}`, Appendix B core helpers; NQL replicated client-side) with an honest no-JS line ("the first batch only; nothing more is reachable"). Reaches: §16 fields 5/7/8/9, §0 settlement 4, Block 1 "Load-more button", A18-15, A34-6 (its line "the button walks the whole archive, unlike A18·15's"), registry §2.1 #24 and §7, FR-G4, FR-G7 rule 3, FR-H2.
- **buildable with a stated change** — **16's count line "Showing 6 of 12"** — claim: counts the section's query. Evidence: `{{#get "posts" … as |posts pages|}}` exposes the query's pagination object (appendix-b1 §5 "Block params: the second is the pagination object"); on the main feed `pagination.total` is at the root (§3). Verdict: buildable — and it settles the carry-forward's "canonical post-count" for A17/A18: both use the **query's own `pagination.total`**, never `count.posts`. Needs no execution beyond NE-A17-4. Reaches: §16 field 7, carry-forward "Data & FR-H2", A34 Block 2 (`pagination.total`).
- **buildable with a stated change** — **11 Masonry's three column-major `<ul>`s** — claim: "three server-rendered lists" (§11 field 9). Evidence: Ghost's `{{#foreach}}` accepts `limit`, `from`, `to` (docs.ghost.org/themes/helpers/functional/foreach), so `from="1" to="3"` / `from="4" to="6"` / `from="7" to="9"` slice a `posts` array on the native context and inside a `{{#get}}` block alike. Verdict: buildable — **but the slice bounds depend on the Columns control (Two · Three) and on Count**, which makes Columns a control that changes DOM structure, not a data-attribute (see §4, AD-3). Reaches: §11 fields 6/9/10, AD-3, registry §2.2 "Masonry walls — CSS `columns`".
- **buildable with a stated change** — **the tag plate (all image-bearing designs)** — claim: missing `feature_image` → a designed plate carrying the primary tag. Evidence: FR-H8 defines exactly two behaviours (text → static fallback; media → hide the element) and says the two must not be collapsed; a substitute element is `{{#if feature_image}}<img>{{else}}<div class="plate">{{/if}}` — the two-armed conditional that §7.3's missing-construct table item 3 says the vocabulary cannot yet express. Verdict: buildable once item 3 lands; FR-H8 needs a third, per-binding media behaviour ("substitute a designed placeholder"). Reaches: FR-H8, §7.3 item 3, §0 settlement 2, Block 1 "Tag plate", A18/A19/A20/A21/A27 (inherit the plate).
- **buildable with a stated change** — **`<img alt>` and `srcset`** — claim: `alt` is `feature_image_alt` "or `alt=""`" (§0 Structure). Evidence: both official themes and the research's generator rule 5 fall back to `{{title}}` (`research-ghost-empty-values.md` §1.2, §5.5, Appendix rule 5), which is what a generic compiler guard will emit. The spec's reason (the whole card is one `<a>` named by the title, so a titled image would be announced twice) is sound, but must be stated as a **per-design override of the compiler's alt rule**, or the compiler will silently do the other thing. Also: no design states its `sizes` attribute or the `package.json` `image_sizes` keys it relies on — size keys are theme-defined (research §5.4) and NFR-2 asserts correct `srcset` in CI; the cell widths (636 · 416 · 306 · 240 · 196, 480 full-bleed, 120/96 thumbs) are what `sizes` must be derived from. Verdict: buildable with both stated. Reaches: §0 Structure, every image-bearing design, FR-H8 ("Media guards must enclose any `srcset`"), §7.3 five constructs #4, NFR-2, research §5.
- **needs-execution** — **gated posts in every A17 feed** — claim: cards bind `excerpt` (D30 fallback = Ghost's generated plaintext) and `reading_time`. Evidence: `{{#foreach posts}}` defaults `visibility` to `'all'` for posts (appendix-b1 §4.1; research-ghost-binding-contexts §"Inside {{#foreach posts}}"), so members-only and paid posts appear in every feed; what `{{excerpt}}` and `reading_time` render for a paid post to an anonymous visitor (is the plaintext the fallback reads stripped by gating?) is read nowhere in the companions. Verdict: **needs execution** (NE-A17-2) — if gating empties the plaintext, D30's fallback silently fails on exactly the sites that gate. Reaches: D30, Block 2 (`excerpt`, `reading_time`, `visibility` "read and never drawn"), A18, A19, A27, catalog `card.members_only`/`card.paid_only` (unused — see §3).
- **needs-execution** — **reading time through the catalog** — claim: "9 min read" (§0 card). Evidence: the catalog key is `post.reading_time` "{minutes} min read" (appendix-h1 §3.3) with an ICU placeholder, while Ghost's `{{reading_time}}` helper formats with its own `minute=`/`minutes=` strings; emitting `{{t "post.reading_time" minutes=reading_time}}` requires `reading_time` to exist as a post **attribute** inside `{{#foreach posts}}` (Appendix B lists it on Post; appendix-b1 §4.1 lists `reading_time` in scope but as a helper name). Verdict: **needs execution** (NE-A17-3). Reaches: §0 card, Meta enum values 3–5, catalog §3.3, FR-H5 shim list, A18/A19/A26.
- **consistent** — `excerpt` binds Ghost's `{{excerpt}}` with the custom-excerpt-first fallback (research §3.4; Appendix B's trap honoured — framed excerpts stay `custom_excerpt`-only, which is A19-13 and nothing here) = D30 ✓ · excerpt clamp via `-webkit-line-clamp` = FR-G8's one allowed prefix set ✓ · `aspect-ratio`, `object-fit`, `grid-row` spans, `position: sticky` (6's Head sticky), `:nth-child` ratio cycle — all Baseline Widely; `color-mix()` (7's derivations) reached Widely ≈ 2025-11, inside the 2026-08-18 pin — `stylelint-plugin-use-baseline` is the check (NE-A17-6) · FR-H4 rule 2 honoured ("Zero published → the section does not render") ✓ · D5 Hand-picked present in Source ✓ · D6: Count is one stepper 1–100 with per-design min/max and locked values drawn disabled — **a per-design max (1–24, 2–30, locked 5) is exactly what D6 permits** ("per-design min/max and locked values") ✓ · 15's "All" pill is `archive.filter_all` "All" (appendix-h1 §3.10) ✓ — the spec should name the key · `{{date … format="D MMMM YYYY"}}` follows the site locale, no catalog key (appendix-h1 §5) ✓ · no `shuffle`, no `infinite-scroll`, no `reveal`, no `typewriter`, no `lightbox` declared ✓ · Member visibility absent: Appendix C scopes it to CTA-bearing categories (A2, A6, A22, A26) ✓ · no custom setting spent ✓ · FR-J15 not applicable ✓.

#### 2 · Contradictions
- **stale-design** — **Roster and [Free] vs the inventory** — inventory lines 364–381 vs the spec's 18 headings (see Counts). The spec marks **no** [Free] design; FR-G2 fixes the first two as [Free], and the inventory's #2 is **Minimal Title Grid (text-only: tag, title, date)** while the spec's #2 is **Two Up (the largest image cell)** — the Free pair changes character (the text-only, image-immune option moves to Pro: 9 Big Type / 10 Ledger). Three PRD locations cite inventory numbering that no longer maps: §7.3 table item 5 "A17 #3/#4/#8/#17/#18", item 7 "A17/A18 per-card tag chips", registry §2.2 "A17 #7 masonry" and "A17 #12 gradient hover". Precedent: D11 re-derived A31 at the merge; do the same here and re-map [Free]. Reaches: inventory 362–381, FR-G1/G2, §7.3 items 5/7, registry §2.2, Synthesis Defaults ("A17 #1 Classic Cards … All meta toggles on" — the spec's #1 has a Meta enum, not toggles).
- **prd-defect** / contradiction — **Pagination style's value set** — spec: Numbered · Newer and older · Load more · None (§0 Data table); FR-H2: Numbered / Load More / Infinite scroll; A34 spec line 10: the select's values are **A34's ten designs**; inventory A34 line 652 agrees. Two conflicts and one hole: (a) A17/A18 "refuse `infinite-scroll` category-wide" while FR-H2 lists it and A34-9/10 ship it — on the main feed the feed cannot refuse a value the PRD puts on its own control (A34 line 58 already argues the difference); (b) "None" on a designated main feed is a state FR-H2 never defines — Ghost still serves `/page/N/` (appendix-b1 §10) and nothing links to them; (c) a four-value enum cannot select among ten designs. The PRD's language wins (carry-forward): the control is A34's ten, "None" needs a ruling. Reaches: §0 settlement 4, Data table, §16 ("Pagination style locked at Load more"), A18 §0, A34 §0/line 10/58, inventory 651–652, FR-H2, FR-Q9.
- Contradiction — **"This route's posts" as a Source value** — designation is a template lifecycle in FR-H2 (first feed auto-designates; deleting/hiding transfers; the user reassigns; the editor marks it) and the spec's Finding 13 concedes it is "a template fact, not a section setting". As a Source value it must be unofferable on `post`, `page`, `error`, `private` and every non-collection custom route (no `posts` at root — appendix-b1 §3), which FR-H7 handles by prevention but the spec never states; P0·5's Filter list has no such value either. Reaches: §0 Data table, Findings 13, FR-H2, FR-H7, appendix-b1 §3/§3a, P0·5, A18 §0, A19.
- Contradiction (FR-H2) — **Count and Order stay live on the main feed** — "On an archive route Ghost's pagination governs and Show is ignored, disclosed in the panel" (§0 settlement 4; §16 field 7). FR-H2: the main feed is "sized by the global `posts_per_page` … instead of a Count", the canvas "reads whichever value actually applies", and the Synthesis Defaults say "no Count control". An ignored control is, by the spec's own rule, "a control that lies". Worse: seven designs cap below the default `posts_per_page` of 12 (2 Two Up ≤ 6, 9 ≤ 8, 5 ≤ 9, 12 locked at 5, 7/17/18 ≤ 12) and settlement 1 says "More than the count → the extra posts are not drawn" — on a main feed that makes posts on every page **unreachable anywhere on the site**. Fix: at the designated feed Count/Order hide (P0·5's own Hand-picked convention) and the count line reports the route's value (`@config.posts_per_page`, or the route's `limit:` — appendix-b1 §2); a design whose hard max is below the page size warns or is unavailable as main feed. Reaches: FR-H2, FR-Q1, FR-I2, Synthesis Defaults §3–4, §0 Data table, designs 2/5/7/9/12/17/18, §16, A18.
- Contradiction (FR-D20 / carry-forward) — **`load-more` edit-safe status** — A17-16: "Edit-safe; persists nothing"; A18-15 and A34-6: "Edit-safe: the module does not run while editing". FR-D20 defines edit-safe as **runs always on the canvas**; a module that waits for Preview is edit-safe: *no*. The carry-forward states `lightbox` is the only "edit-safe: no" module — A18-15/A34-6's wording contradicts it, and the registry (research §7) carries no edit-safe column at all, so FR-D20's "each module declares itself" has no home. Reaches: FR-D20, registry §2.1/§7, A17-15 ("Edit-safe"), A17-16, A18-15, A34-6/7, carry-forward "Registry".
- Contradiction (one module, two behaviours) — **focus after a Load More press** — A17-16 §10: "Focus stays on the button after a press"; A18-15 §10 and A34-6 §10: "focus moves to the first new post's link". A module's focus rule belongs to the module (FR-G7 rule 2 — a module ships with its section, but it is one module). Reaches: registry #24, A17-16 §10, A18-15 §10, A34-6 §10 and §0 settlement 4.
- Contradiction (Appendix C / FR-E1) — **16's Button "Outline · Solid · Text"** borrows the Style Pack's Button style scale (Solid/Soft/Outline/Pill — FR-E1, Appendix C "closed and distinct … no surface borrows another scale's labels") as a per-design control, and "24 px radius" fixes what the pack's radius token (Sharp/Soft/Round) owns. Reaches: §16 field 6, Block 1 "Load-more button", A18-15, A34-6, FR-E1, Appendix C.
- Contradiction (Appendix C / D7) — **17 Panel's Inset "Compact 32 · Comfortable 56 · Spacious 80"** and 7's band scale reuse the Vertical spacing labels for a different section ladder; Appendix C forbids borrowing scale labels and D7 says "rename genuinely different ladders". Reaches: §17 field 6, §7 field 6, Appendix C scale table, D7, A18's Row density (same issue, five ladders).
- Contradiction (vocabulary) — **Background role written "Background · Surface · Contrast"**, 8 "locked at Background" — the inventory (line 21) declares the Swatch Row as **Base/Surface/Accent/Contrast/Image** and the Synthesis Defaults default it to **Base**. "Background" is off-vocabulary and the three-value subset drops Accent/Image without a stated reason. Reaches: §0 shared floor, §7, §8, inventory line 21, Appendix C, A18 §0.
- Contradiction (spec vs A34 on placement) — **17 Panel "A34 attaches below the panel, on the page ground"**, 18 "at the page margin rather than the band's edge" — A34's Pager block makes this a field (Attachment: Joined = inside the feed's container 48 px below the last row · Separate) and the inventory (line 651) says A34 is "rendered inside the designated main feed's section". The feed cannot both own the select and pre-empt one of its fields. Reaches: §17 field 7 and Reconciled, §18 Reconciled, A18-7/12, A34 §0 settlement 3 + Pager block, inventory 651.
- Contradiction (D10 / appendix-h1) — **strings**: (a) 16's exhausted line "That's all 12 posts." vs A18-15 "All 15 posts shown" vs A34-6 `endLabel` "That's all {total} posts." — three wordings for one meaning; the catalog's nearest key `pagination.end_of_feed` ("You're all caught up", migrating to `pagination.feed_complete` per §6) has no `{total}` placeholder, and adding one is an S2 meaning change requiring a **new key**; (b) "Showing 6 of 12" — `pagination.showing_range` is "{from}–{to} of {total}" (different placeholder set); A34 proposes "{seen} of {total} posts"; S9 says the key exists **before** the design is authored; (c) `buttonLabel` authored with default "Load more" — mechanical chrome is D10's catalog branch (`pagination.load_more` exists); S6 permits a catalog default to seed a prop only if the key is named as that prop's initial value, which the spec does not do; (d) `emptyBody` default "There are no posts on this page yet. Try the archive." vs `archive.empty_body` "There are no posts in this collection yet." — the catalog is normative on strings (precedence rank 3) and marks both keys `prop`, so the authored-with-default model is right but the default must be the catalog's, and "Try the archive" names a route the product has not picked (carry-forward "all-posts/all-tags routes"). Reaches: appendix-h1 §3.1/§3.10/§6 + rule S2/S6/S9, D10, FR-Q6, §0 settlement 1, Block 2, §16 Reconciled, Findings 12, A18-5/15, A34-6.
- Contradiction (spec ↔ A18) — **6 Split Head "Head sticky"** appears only in 6's Reconciled control list (not in field 6) while A18-6 says "Sticky head refused, as in A8·6 and A17·6". Reaches: §6 field 6 vs Reconciled, A18-6 field 9, A8-6.
- Contradiction (spec ↔ A18 ↔ A34) — **7 Contrast Band's Vertical spacing resolution**: A17-7 "64 · 88 · 120"; A18-7 "80 · 96 · 132"; A34 line 131 "Compact raised to 80 (A17·7)". One universal control, three readings on one ground. Reaches: §7 field 3/6, A18-7 field 6, A34 §0 settlement 3.
- Contradiction (spec ↔ A19 carry-forward) — **A19's fifth field `fallback` (Hide the section · Show the latest post) is not carried** — the Data table has no `fallback`; "Featured only" with nothing starred renders nothing and offers no "show latest". The carry-forward adopts the field library-wide. Reaches: §0 Data table, Block 2, A19 §0 settlement 1 and Finding 2, carry-forward "Data & FR-H2".
- Contradiction (spec ↔ P0·5) — **Hand-picked hides Count and Order** in P0·5 ("the picked list is the count and the order"); A17 disables Order and keeps Count (12 "Hand-picked is the one Source where the five cells are chosen by hand", 2's 1–6). Two conventions for one primitive. Reaches: §0 Data table, P0·5, A18 §0, A19.
- Contradiction (internal) — **§6 Controls lines vs the Reconciled paragraphs**: 2 (Alignment vs Columns · Title), 3 (Per row + Padding vs Row rule), 5 (Followers appears only in Reconciled), 6 (Head sticky · Posts per row), 8 (Text), 16 (Batch 3·6·9·12 vs Count-is-the-batch 1–100), 17 (Meta · Tag · link). The panel is the authority; the body was not regenerated. Reaches: designs 2, 3, 5, 6, 8, 16, 17; FR-G3 `quickControls[]` (derived from the first entries of the design's list — which list?).

#### 3 · Gaps
- **spec-incomplete** — **By tag / By author filters unnamed**: `tag:{slug}` (any tag) or `primary_tag:{slug}`; `authors:{slug}` or `primary_author:{slug}` (FR-I2's mappings are the vocabulary). 15's strip lists **primary** tags while a By tag query may match **secondary** tags — a pill with no post behind it. Reaches: §0 Data table, §15 field 7, FR-H2, FR-I2, A18, A19, A20, A21.
- **spec-incomplete** — **"View all" link "Matches the query"**: no Ghost route exists for Featured only, Hand-picked or Latest (home? an all-posts route?); By tag resolves to the tag's `url`, whose prefix is routes.yaml-dependent (compile-known since Inflozo authors routes — FR-I2 — or a second `{{#get "tags" filter="slug:x" limit="1"}}`); By author to the author's `url`. Which Sources offer the value and what the rest resolve to is unstated. Reaches: §0 head, Block 2 `linkTarget`, all 18 Reconciled, A18, carry-forward "Product mechanisms".
- **spec-incomplete** — **Runtime hand-offs are undefined as a mechanism**: "No image on any post → 8/11/18 hand off to 9 Big Type", "11 below five → 1 Three Up", "12 under five → 2 Two Up", "silently on the site". A hand-off at render time is a second design's markup and CSS compiled into the same section plus a predicate — "any image in the set" needs a probe `{{#get}}` with `feature_image:-null` (FR-I2's NQL) replicating the route's filter, and "fewer than five returned" needs `posts.length` (Source's `{{#match posts.length ">=" 7}}` proves the shape — research-ghost-empty-values §1.1 Pattern F). See §4 for the owner. Reaches: §0 settlements 1–2, designs 2, 8, 11, 12, 18, A18-2/10.
- **spec-incomplete** — **15's "Chosen tags" is an authored ref list** and carries no P0·3 add/remove/reorder (register item 44: every authored list carries them). Reaches: §15 field 6, P0·3, register 44.
- **spec-incomplete** — **aborted `{{#get}}`** (appendix-b1 §5: empty collection + a visible `<span data-aborted-get-helper>`): "zero → does not render" must wrap the whole section, heading included, in the block-param `{{#if posts}}`; the span still renders. Unstated. Reaches: §0 settlement 1, FR-H4, FR-H8.
- **Gap (inventory union)** — the inventory's union declares image aspect **Natural** (uncropped) and **None**, card frame **Elevated**, meta position **Above title / Below title** (line 363); no spec design carries any of them — every ratio crops, no design elevates at rest, meta is always last. ## A18 · Post Lists
**Counts (derived):** designs on disk 15 (16 frames `A18-0`…`A18-15` − proof) · spec 15 (`### 1 · Rows` … `### 15 · Load More`) · inventory 15 (`sections-inventory.md` line 383 "Post Lists (15)") · [Free] spec **none marked** (`grep -c Free` = 0 in the spec and in `A18-0 Category Proof.dc.html`) / inventory #1 Editorial Rules, #2 Thumb Left (≈ spec 1 Rows, 2 Thumb Rows — the one clean [Free] mapping in the two categories) · modules declared: `load-more` (15) — registry §2.1 #24; `core` assumed; "no registry addition is needed by this pass" (§0 Behaviour) · custom-setting slots: 0 · authored lists: 0 (`otherGroupLabel` and `buttonLabel` are text props, not lists) · Ghost-bound lists: 15 (the posts query, P0·5 in every design; Hand-picked `postRefs` is a reference list with reorder/unpick and no Add).

**Roster note (derive, don't trust):** inventory lines 385–399 name Editorial Rules, Thumb Left, Big Date, Minimal Index, Excerpt Rich, Numbered Archive, Month Grouped, Two-Column Index, **Hover Reveal**, Card List, Serif Journal, Split Date Rail, Reading-Time Focus, Compact Dense, Letterhead Rows. The spec ships Rows, Thumb Rows, Slim, Dated, Grouped, Split Head, Contrast Band, Row Cards, Big Type, Lead and List, Numbered, Panel, Timeline, Index, Load More. Five inventory designs have no counterpart (Excerpt Rich, Hover Reveal, Serif Journal, Reading-Time Focus, Letterhead Rows) and six spec designs are new (Split Head, Contrast Band, Big Type, Lead and List, Panel, Load More). **The brief's two named mechanisms are both absent by design choice:** no A18 design uses hover-reveal `:has()` (the inventory's #9 is gone — and it was buildable, `:has()` being Baseline Widely 2026-06-19, registry §2.2), and 5 Grouped **refuses** sticky headings ("a section is not a scrolling pane") where registry §2.2 lists "A18 #7 sticky month/year" under `position: sticky`. See §2.

#### 1 · Ghost feasibility
- **ghost-infeasible** (and a **prd-defect** in §7.3) — **5 Grouped, Group by Month · Year · Tag** — claim: "grouping happens in Handlebars, not the browser … No-JS: pixel-identical" (§5 field 9); "Rules run inside a group and stop at its end"; "a row never repeats what its heading says"; "at Group by Tag, groups are ordered by each group's newest post". Evidence: emitting a heading when a field changes between items needs the previous item, and Handlebars exposes none — `appendix-b1-template-contexts.md` §4.1 lists the complete loop-local set (`@index`, `@number`, `@first`, `@last`, `@even`, `@odd`, `@key`, `@rowStart/@rowEnd`), Ghost ships no arithmetic, no `lookup`-with-offset and no logic helpers (`research-ghost-empty-values.md` §3.1: "no `{{or}}`, no `{{and}}`, no `{{not}}` … no subexpression logic helpers at all"), and `{{#match}}` compares two values it is handed, not an item against its predecessor (§2.3). One `{{#get}}` per calendar month needs bounds unknown at compile (FR-I2's relative `now-1M` is thirty days, not a month) and a `{{#get}}` per tag inside `{{#get "tags"}}` reads render context in its filter — forbidden by FR-H5/FR-G3. Group by Tag additionally needs the posts sorted by `primary_tag`, an order on a relation the Content API does not document (NE-A18-3). **§7.3's missing-construct table item 8 ("Group-by / change detection — A18 #7, A20 #12, A21 #15") records the need and assumes E4 can supply it; Handlebars cannot.** Verdict: **not buildable on Ghost** as specified. Stated change: a client-side grouping module (P0·8 rule 4: "ARCHITECT: registry addition", no-JS = the flat ruled list — which contradicts the design's own "pixel-identical" claim and must be said), or cut 5 and let routes/tags do the grouping. Reaches: §5 fields 1–10 and Reconciled, §0 settlement 3 (`{{date}}` locale confirmation), Block 1 "Group heading"/"Authored terminal-group label", §7.3 item 8, A20 #12, A21 #15, registry §2.2 "Sticky panels/rails … A18 #7".
- **ghost-infeasible** (contradicts FR-H2) — **15 Load More at any Source other than the main feed** — claim: "the button stops at Count; it does not walk the whole archive" (§15 field 7), no-JS "Ghost's numbered `/page/2/` pagination links render instead". Evidence: identical to A17-16 — FR-H2 "All other feed sections are `{{#get}}`-driven: fixed Count, never paginated"; registry §2.1 #24 defines `load-more` for A34 #2/#7/#8 over the route's pages; A34-6: "each press fetches the next `/page/N/` … the batch is always `posts_per_page`". And on the one Source where it can work, the spec itself says "On an archive route Ghost's pagination governs and Batch is ignored" and "Pagination style is locked at Load more" — so Batch size (Five · Ten) and Count-as-reachable-total, the two fields that define this design, are inert on the main feed and impossible off it. Verdict: **not buildable** as specified. Stated change: 15 is main-feed-only (= 2 Thumb Rows + Pagination style Load more = A34-6) or the registry gains a Content-API `load-more` with an honest no-JS line. Reaches: §15 fields 5/6/7/8/9, §0 settlement 4 "Pagination", Findings 1 (`count` reinterpretation), A17-16, A34-6, registry #24 + §7, FR-H2, FR-G4.
- **ghost-infeasible** — **11 Numbered as the designated main feed on page N** — claim: "the numeral counts the drawn list from the top, always" (§11 field 7). Evidence: `@number` restarts at 1 in every `{{#foreach}}` (appendix-b1 §4.1); continuing to 13 on `/page/2/` needs `(page−1)·limit+1` and Handlebars/Ghost has no arithmetic (research §3.1); an `<ol start>` cannot be computed. Verdict: numbering restarts at 01 on every page — **buildable only if the spec states the restart** (or bars 11 as main feed). Reaches: §11 field 7, FR-D21, FR-H2.
- **needs-execution** + **arch-gap** — **Hand-picked ordering (all 15)** — same evidence as A17 (Finding 10 here: "Ghost's `#get` helper does not preserve an arbitrary order for free — and 11 Numbered draws an ordinal over whatever order it is handed, so a silent re-sort would renumber the list"). A18's Hand-picked ceilings are its Count bounds (25 on 1/4/5/11/13, 30 on 3/14). Verdict: **needs execution** (NE-A18-1 = NE-A17-1) and an ordering contract with a ceiling. Reaches: §0 Data table, Block 2 `postRefs`, Findings 10, D5, P0·5, FR-H2, §7.3 item 2.
- **buildable with a stated change** — **14 Index, Order: Title A–Z** — claim: "a server-side `title asc`" (§14 field 7). Evidence: `{{#get}}` accepts `order` on post fields (docs.ghost.org/themes/helpers/functional/get — `order="title asc"`). Verdict: buildable on a `{{#get}}` feed; **not on the main feed**, whose order is the route's — a `routes.yaml` collection accepts `order:`, but FR-I2's Routes Manager offers no order field (prefix, filter, template, page size only), so Title A–Z at "This route's posts" has no path. FR-H2's Order enum (Newest/Oldest) also gains a value. Reaches: §14 fields 6/7/9, §0 "Order is a rule", Block 1 "Alphabetical order value", FR-H2, FR-I2, NE-A18-3.
- **buildable** (useful confirmation) — **10 Lead and List: the lead outside the `<ul>` as its own `<article>`** — Ghost's `{{#foreach}}` takes `limit`, `from`, `to` (docs.ghost.org/themes/helpers/functional/foreach), so the lead is `{{#foreach posts limit="1"}}` and the followers `{{#foreach posts from="2"}}` — two passes over one array, valid HTML in each, which is what the annotated-HTML single-source model needs (§7.3 forbids unbalanced tags inside a conditional). Same mechanism carries A17-11's slices. Reaches: §10 fields 3/10, §7.3 item 5, NE-A17-4.
- **buildable** (useful confirmation) — **11 Numbered, Zero-padded** — `{{#match @number "<" 10}}0{{/match}}{{@number}}`: `{{#match}}` takes a three-argument operator form with `<` and compares by type (research-ghost-empty-values §2.3); `@number` is numeric (appendix-b1 §4.1). No CSS counter needed, which is what the spec wants ("rendered into the markup"). Probe NE-A18-4 confirms the type. Reaches: §11 field 9.
- **buildable** (useful confirmation) — **4 Dated's "computed" date column** ("longest rendered date + 24, floored at 96 — the one measured-rather-than-named dimension in A18, for localisation") — CSS does this without measuring: `grid-template-columns: minmax(96px, max-content) 1fr`. State it, so nobody reaches for a module. Reaches: §4 field 10, §13 (same column).
- **buildable with a stated change** — **14 Index "columns balanced by count, not height — 15 across three is 5·5·5"** with "one `<ul>` flowed into columns by CSS" — CSS multi-column balances by **height** (`column-fill: balance`), and the spec's own field 8 says an untagged entry is 21 px shorter at Detail Title and tag, so the browser will not give 5·5·5 there. Count balance holds only where entries are equal-height (Title only; Title and date, "nothing can be missing"). Either say so, or use three sliced lists (A17-11's structure, with its AD-3 problem). Reaches: §14 fields 7/8/10, registry §2.2 masonry row, A17-11.
- **spec-incomplete** (FR-G4 AA) — **7 Contrast Band, dark**: "the dark band takes the light accent at 4.42:1 and only clears AA as large text, drawn as a 14 px semibold underline". WCAG 2.1 SC 1.4.3 defines large-scale text as ≥ 18 pt, or ≥ 14 pt **bold** (14 pt ≈ 18.66 px); 14 px at 600 is neither, so 4.42:1 **fails AA** for text. If the accent is only the underline decoration and the text keeps the band's text colour, 1.4.3 does not apply — but that reading must be stated; as written the claim is false. Reaches: §7 field 10, FR-G4 (AA scoped to shipped packs), the on-contrast token ask (§4).
- **needs-execution** — **gated posts in every A18 feed** (1's excerpt, 3's Trailing: Reading time, 9's meta): `{{#foreach posts}}` defaults `visibility` to `'all'` (appendix-b1 §4.1; research-ghost-binding-contexts "Inside {{#foreach posts}}"); what `{{excerpt}}`/`reading_time` render for a paid post to a non-member is read nowhere. NE-A18-2 (= NE-A17-2). Reaches: D30, Block 2, §1/§3/§9.
- **needs-execution** — **reading time through `{{t}}`** (`post.reading_time` "{minutes} min read", appendix-h1 §3.3, vs Ghost's helper) — NE-A18-5 (= NE-A17-3). Reaches: §0 Meta row, §3 Trailing, catalog §3.3.
